title: PS Plus December: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 leads 🛹
subject: psplus
description:
Which one are you playing first? 👇

Sony revealed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026 on the PlayStation Blog: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 (PS5, PS4), Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 (PS5, PS4) and Amnesia: The Bunker (PS4). They are available from December 1, 2026 to January 4, 2027. November's games (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) can be added until November 30.

Sources: PlayStation Blog, Adam Michel (Nov 25, 2026), Kotaku (Nov 25, 2026)
Game footage/images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 hits PS Plus December 1.
Sony's Adam Michel revealed the December lineup on the PlayStation Blog on November 25.
The skating remake comes to PS5 and PS4, with custom goals you can share with friends for the first time.
Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is the second pick.
The third is Amnesia: The Bunker on PS4, a World War I horror game where you start with one bullet.
All three can be claimed until January 4.
